description.value: D Spot Dessert Café is a Canadian dessert franchise established in 2014, specializing in homemade ice cream, fresh waffles and crepes, Belgian chocolate creations, and savoury items. The Delta location is part of a growing national chain known for inventive, social-media-worthy desserts made with high-quality ingredients. All products are halal-certified and kosher, making this a broadly inclusive stop for cyclists seeking a sweet break.
